name: Profile Card
description: Interactive holographic profile card with a photo tile, name and title overlay, and a footer with handle, status and contact button. Tilts in 3D and shows foil and glare effects that follow the pointer.
contents: Photo tile with name and title overlay on a bottom scrim
Holographic foil, glow and glare layers
Footer with optional mini avatar, @handle, colored status dot and contact button with mail icon
behavior: Spring-driven 3D tilt and photo parallax follow the mouse pointer over the card
Holographic foil, light glare and shade follow the pointer and fade out on leave
Touch drags aim the effect while a finger is down and release on lift
Intro animation sweeps the light across the card on mount
Optional device orientation tilt on mobile, enabled on first tap with iOS permission prompt
Tilt and parallax are disabled when the user prefers reduced motion
Contact button has hover, press and focus states
editableByProps: Photo, mini avatar, name, title, handle, status text and color, contact label and click handler
Dark or light theme, tile backdrop color, corner radius
Holographic and glare intensity, optional icon pattern for the foil mask
Tilt on or off, tilt strength, parallax depth, mobile tilt and its sensitivity, intro animation

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card width or photo aspect ratio

needsCodeEdit.where: HugeiconsIcon with Mail01Icon in the FOOTER block

needsCodeEdit.change: Change theme colors or foil colors
needsCodeEdit.where: THEMES, FOILS, SPECTRUM and BARS constants
stiffness and damping values in the frame function

fixed: Card is a fixed 340px wide (max 100% of parent) with no viewport-centering frame
Needs the @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons packages for the contact button icon
Without avatarUrl the photo area is empty and only the foil backdrop shows
Holographic detail layers only appear in dark foil mode and when iconUrl is set
Name and title overlay show only when provided; footer pieces hide when their value is empty
Mouse, touch and pointer listeners plus a ResizeObserver are attached to the card and removed on unmount
Mobile tilt adds a window deviceorientation listener and may trigger an iOS motion permission prompt on tap
Component is exported wrapped in React memo

options.look: Dark translucent frame with color-dodge holographic foil and bright sheen
options.useWhen: Card sits on a dark or gradient page such as a developer portfolio or gaming community

options.look: Light frosted frame with multiply-blended inverted foil and soft shadows
options.useWhen: Card sits on a white or pastel page such as a team page of a clean SaaS site
